question: whether a load forgets a wing target

struct_fields.name: target_id_type
struct_fields.comment: The type half of the persistent id of the ship this one last shot at; with +0xBC, the remembered target CSubUnit::PickTarget keeps from hour to hour. Cleared by CCombatant::AddUnit and for a ship that cannot shoot. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-seabattle.md, section 4. **Not saved**: a save written during a battle in the air, 2026-11-10, holds no such key, and a load clears it as each unit joins (reversing/findings/FINDINGS-savedbattle.md, A.6; reversing/findings/FINDINGS-liveread.md, section 10).
struct_fields.evidence: The join step on load, already read in reversing/findings/FINDINGS-savedbattle.md, A.6; the save holds no key for it.
struct_fields.revises: the load is read, not inferred
